commits_behind.subject: Screen timeout service; VFA graph without a second sweep
commits_behind.message:
screen-timeout turns the backlight off after a while without a touch and on
at the next touch (which doesn't reach the screen app), as its own startup
service beside GrumpyScreen. Keyboards, gamepads and full-screen games keep
the screen on; the timeout is in screen-timeout.conf in the config folder.
VFA_COMPENSATION passes GRAPH to the calibration, which makes the after sweep.

commits_behind.subject: VFA: auto calibration, graphs, AXIS option, welcome page
commits_behind.message:

per motor to config/vfa. AXIS=X or Y redoes one motor. The welcome dialog
recommends recalibrating VFA once.

commits_behind.author: SpamOmelette
commits_behind.subject: Add pop-up menus for GrumpyScreen and the web UIs (#10)
commits_behind.message:
* Add pop-up menus for GrumpyScreen and the web UIs

New printer.menus.cfg with action:prompt menus for the print options
(flow calibration, purge, purge line, bed mesh, bed soak, clog
detection, lower bed, quiet mode, chamber wait, door notify), filament
loading and dock position per tool, Level + Save (bed temperature and
soak time, then a saved default mesh), and start/cancel confirmations
in front of the long calibrations (extruder rotation, input shaper,
shaper with graphs, VFA, PID).

GrumpyScreen's macro buttons now open these menus. The same macros
show up in Fluidd and Mainsail, and the default Fluidd macro layout
gets them with names and categories.

The soak time picked in the Soak menu is saved as bed_soak_minutes and
passed to C5_BED_SOAK at print start; without it the
[creator5_toolchanger] default still applies.

* Trim the pop-up menus and keep them in printer.macro.cfg

Drop the on/off option menus (the UIs already show those switches), the
Soak menu and its saved soak time, and the rotation and PID confirmation
menus. GrumpyScreen loses those buttons and First Setup, Motors Off and
Beep. The remaining menus move into printer.macro.cfg, so
printer.menus.cfg and its include go.

commits_behind.author: russellshigeoka
commits_behind.subject: Make GrumpyScreen AFC Load run C5_LOAD_FILAMENT, ask to home first
commits_behind.message:
GrumpyScreen's AFC panel Load sends TOOL_LOAD LANE=extruderN, which AFC
handles by only picking the tool up: no heating, purge or dock. Fluidd
sends CHANGE_TOOL, which is already overridden.

- Add a TOOL_LOAD override that runs C5_LOAD_FILAMENT when idle and keeps
  AFC's own command (_AFC_TOOL_LOAD) during print/pause or for bad lanes.
- Add _C5_REQUIRE_HOMED to CHANGE_TOOL and TOOL_LOAD: when X or Y is not
  homed, show a "Home required" prompt (Home now / Close) and stop.
- Document it and add tests.
